label: type I restriction-modification system
definition: A restriction-modification system in which an organism possesses a Type I R-M locus encoding a pentameric enzyme with HsdR-like restriction, HsdM-like methylation, and HsdS-like DNA sequence-recognition subunits, including RM_Type_I loci represented by DefenseFinder.
observations: Type I restriction-modification branch under restriction-modification system; distinct from individual Type I HsdR, HsdM, and HsdS proteins, individual DefenseFinder HMM profile rows, the RM_Type_I source key, PrrC/EcoprrI accessory use of Type I restriction components, and the broader restriction-modification parent.
